topic: Worth sending 04: Logging off is part of the job (out-of-office Reel, music only, quote series experiment)
experiment_note: Worth sending: one-line quote drawn as an everyday object, research in the caption. Judge on sends and follows per view against our usual singles and Reels. Four posts cannot settle anything.
caption:
Logging off can feel like letting people down. It's part of doing the job well.

A review of workplace programs found that simple end-of-day habits can help people switch off: planning unfinished tasks, noting what went well, and putting work messages away.

Send this to the colleague who never logs off.

Worth sending is our new series: one short line, for the person who needs to hear it. These were studies of working adults in general, not people with burnout. And if the workload itself is too much, that sits with the workplace too.

Research:
Agolli, A., & Holtz, B. C. (2023). Facilitating detachment from work: A systematic review, evidence-based recommendations, and guide for future research. Journal of Occupational Health Psychology, 28(3), 129-159. https://doi.org/10.1037/ocp0000353
